# JSON schemas

Every `-o json` and `-o yaml` document starts with `apiVersion: refresh.drod.dev/v1` and a `kind`. Each kind has a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12), generated from the Go types, at `https://drod.dev/refresh/schema/v1/<kind>.json`. The [output contract](../concepts/output.md#compatibility) says what can change within `v1`.

| Kind | Printed by | Schema |
|---|---|---|
| `FleetStatus` | `refresh status` | [FleetStatus.json](../schema/v1/FleetStatus.json) |
| `ClusterList` | `refresh cluster list` | [ClusterList.json](../schema/v1/ClusterList.json) |
| `ClusterDescription` | `refresh cluster describe` | [ClusterDescription.json](../schema/v1/ClusterDescription.json) |
| `UpgradeCheck` | `refresh cluster upgrade-check` | [UpgradeCheck.json](../schema/v1/UpgradeCheck.json) |
| `InsightDescription` | `refresh cluster upgrade-check --id` | [InsightDescription.json](../schema/v1/InsightDescription.json) |
| `UpgradePlan` | `refresh cluster upgrade --dry-run` | [UpgradePlan.json](../schema/v1/UpgradePlan.json) |
| `UpgradeRun` | `refresh cluster upgrade --yes` | [UpgradeRun.json](../schema/v1/UpgradeRun.json) |
| `RollbackPlan` | `refresh cluster rollback --dry-run` | [RollbackPlan.json](../schema/v1/RollbackPlan.json) |
| `RollbackRun` | `refresh cluster rollback --yes` | [RollbackRun.json](../schema/v1/RollbackRun.json) |
| `NodegroupList` | `refresh nodegroup list` | [NodegroupList.json](../schema/v1/NodegroupList.json) |
| `NodegroupDescription` | `refresh nodegroup describe` | [NodegroupDescription.json](../schema/v1/NodegroupDescription.json) |
| `NodegroupScale` | `refresh nodegroup scale` | [NodegroupScale.json](../schema/v1/NodegroupScale.json) |
| `NodegroupUpdate` | `refresh nodegroup update` | [NodegroupUpdate.json](../schema/v1/NodegroupUpdate.json) |
| `NodegroupUpdatePlan` | `refresh nodegroup update --dry-run` | [NodegroupUpdatePlan.json](../schema/v1/NodegroupUpdatePlan.json) |
| `FleetUpdate` | `refresh nodegroup update --all-clusters` | [FleetUpdate.json](../schema/v1/FleetUpdate.json) |
| `FleetUpdatePlan` | `refresh nodegroup update --all-clusters --dry-run` | [FleetUpdatePlan.json](../schema/v1/FleetUpdatePlan.json) |
| `HealthSummary` | `refresh nodegroup update --health-only` | [HealthSummary.json](../schema/v1/HealthSummary.json) |
| `AddonList` | `refresh addon list` | [AddonList.json](../schema/v1/AddonList.json) |
| `AddonDescription` | `refresh addon describe` | [AddonDescription.json](../schema/v1/AddonDescription.json) |
| `AddonUpdate` | `refresh addon update` | [AddonUpdate.json](../schema/v1/AddonUpdate.json) |
| `AddonUpdateAll` | `refresh addon update --all` | [AddonUpdateAll.json](../schema/v1/AddonUpdateAll.json) |

Validate a document with any draft 2020-12 validator, for example:

```bash
refresh cluster list -o json > clusters.json
check-jsonschema --schemafile https://drod.dev/refresh/schema/v1/ClusterList.json clusters.json
```
